en: Black‑and‑white view of an elaborate baroque palace complex beside a water-filled moat or canal. In the foreground is a landscaped path with trees and flowerbeds; to the right stands a long, richly decorated gallery façade with many identical arched windows and balustrades. A domed gate pavilion surmounted by a large crown-like finial rises prominently from the wall. A pedestrian bridge crosses the water toward the pavilion, with small figures walking across. The sky is bright with scattered clouds; there is no visible printed caption on the front.
